## Checklist

- [ ] `uv lock --check`, `uv run ruff check .`, `uv run mypy`, `uv run pytest -q` pass locally
- [ ] Tests use only fictional data; no real student data, cookies or captures are included
- [ ] JSON output, exit codes and command arguments are unchanged (or a versioning plan is linked)
- [ ] GET-only / exact-origin / TLS guarantees are untouched (or the change is explained)
- [ ] Docs and CHANGELOG updated if user-visible
